# GlowTour.js

> GlowTour.js is a cross-framework guided-tour library: one core workflow engine with native
> adapters for React, Vue, Solid, Angular, and vanilla JavaScript. It renders accessible,
> SSR-safe product tours and onboarding flows, and ships as ESM only.

Packages: `@glowhop/core-tour` (framework-agnostic engine, no presentation), plus
`@glowhop/react-tour`, `@glowhop/vue-tour`, `@glowhop/solid-tour`, `@glowhop/angular-tour`,
`@glowhop/vanilla-tour`, and `@glowhop/styles-tour` (default theme). All are published on npm,
e.g. https://www.npmjs.com/package/@glowhop/core-tour. Source and issues:
https://github.com/Glowhop/GlowTour.js

## Docs

- [Overview](https://glowtour.dev/docs): Introduction to GlowTour.js guided tours library.
- [Getting started](https://glowtour.dev/docs/getting-started): Install GlowTour.js and build your first guided tour.
- [Compatibility](https://glowtour.dev/docs/compatibility): Framework versions and SSR support verified for each adapter.

## Comparisons

- [Compare](https://glowtour.dev/compare): GlowTour.js vs Driver.js, Shepherd.js and React Joyride in one table, on framework support, customization, accessibility, API design and licensing.
- [GlowTour.js vs Driver.js](https://glowtour.dev/glowtour-vs-driver-js): Framework integrations, UI customization, builder API, accessibility and licensing.
- [GlowTour.js vs Shepherd.js](https://glowtour.dev/glowtour-vs-shepherd-js): Framework integrations, customization model, API ergonomics and licensing (MIT vs AGPL-3.0).
- [GlowTour.js vs React Joyride](https://glowtour.dev/glowtour-vs-react-joyride): React-only vs framework-agnostic, Vue and Angular support, UI customization.
